video_title: Steve Kerr harps on Warriors’ defense to step up vs. Celtics | NBC Sports Bay Area

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on the lack of rhythm in Warriors' offense
quotes.excerpt: There's a difference between an open shot and an open shot with rhythm.
quotes.quote: There's a difference between an open shot and an open shot with rhythm. We're getting some open shots, but I don't think there's a rhythm to them. So they're less likely to go in. If you get a paint touch, kick out, open three, that's what you're looking for. It doesn't feel like we're getting a ton of those. So ball pressure in the last couple games hurt us, so we worked hard yesterday in practice on some things trying to generate better rhythm to our offense.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr says the Warriors offense lacks rhythm and they have been working on generating better flow in practice to combat recent ball pressure issues.

structured.context: Steve Kerr discusses the lack of offensive rhythm and the team's need to improve ball movement.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr identifies defense as the team's primary area for improvement
quotes.excerpt: When you've lost five in a row, you dig it out with defense.
quotes.quote: Defense. The offense is what it is and we can tweak things and shots sometimes go in, sometimes they don't. But when you've lost five in a row, you dig it out with defense and get stops and run. We've got to grind out a win here to get out of the rut.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr says the Warriors need to dig out of their five game losing streak with defense. He emphasizes that the team must grind out a win to get out of this rut.

structured.context: Steve Kerr explains that the team must prioritize defense to break their current losing streak.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on Trayce Jackson-Davis's role and development
quotes.excerpt: We like him down on the low block. He's got a natural instinct down there to score.
quotes.quote: We like him down on the low block. He's got a natural instinct down there to score, create an advantage and we definitely want to see more of that. As far as the conversations, it's all about getting through a rookie season where you have so much to learn and there's so much being thrown at him. We're just trying to get him to understand that it's going to take some time and he just has to focus on the detail. I'm way more interested in watching his defense tonight than his offense. Same thing with our team. If we get stops and defend, the offense will come around for individuals and for the team.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr on Trayce Jackson-Davis: I am way more interested in watching his defense tonight than his offense. He says the rookie is still learning to navigate the ups and downs of the NBA season.

structured.context: Steve Kerr discusses rookie Trayce Jackson-Davis's development and the need for him to focus on defensive details.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on using Draymond Green at the center position
quotes.excerpt: We're playing him with Trayce Jackson-Davis. He'll be at the four a little bit more.
quotes.quote: We're playing him with Trayce Jackson-Davis. He'll be at the four a little bit more, which so we can deploy him in slightly different ways than when he's at the five and then he'll find his way to the corner more often at the four. We want him to shoot corner threes, open threes for sure, but it's more about the defense than anything. He's still one of the great defenders in the league. He'll guard Jason Tatum tonight plenty along with some other guys, but I'm mostly focused on can we get stops, can we generate some turnovers, some bad shots that can help us offensively.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr plans to deploy Draymond Green at the four more often to utilize his size and perimeter defense. He says he is focused on generating turnovers and bad shots to help the offense.

structured.context: Steve Kerr explains the tactical shift of moving Draymond Green to the power forward position alongside Trayce Jackson-Davis.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on Brandon Podziemski and Trayce Jackson-Davis's recent struggles
quotes.excerpt: With Steph out, the other teams now put their two best defenders on them.
quotes.quote: Obviously with both pods and Trayce Jackson-Davis, with Steph out, the other teams now put their two best defenders on them, make things a lot more difficult. So neither guy really found a great rhythm scoring, shooting the ball. But again, that's all part of the season and coming back home will be helpful. Both guys had such a great start to the season and going into that road trip, everybody felt great and was in rhythm and we come back limping a little bit. This is all about changing the tide again.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr notes that with Steph Curry out, opposing teams are putting their two best defenders on Podziemski and Jackson-Davis, making it harder for them to find a scoring rhythm.

structured.context: Steve Kerr explains that Brandin Podziemski and Trayce Jackson-Davis are facing tougher defensive coverage while Stephen Curry is sidelined.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on the importance of ball movement and team rhythm
quotes.excerpt: You tend to find rhythm the harder you play and the better you play defensively.
quotes.quote: You tend to find rhythm the harder you play and the better you play defensively. Then you gain an advantage in transition and then the ball moves a couple times, somebody makes a three and everybody feels good and the crowd is into it. So that's really what I'm looking for. We always look at strategic tweaks, things we can run to get a guy the ball in a certain spot, but offense is all about trying to gain an advantage, get a defensive rotation and we weren't gaining many advantages on the trip so the ball wasn't moving quite as well.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr says offense is all about gaining an advantage and forcing defensive rotations, noting the Warriors were not gaining many advantages during their recent road trip.

structured.context: Steve Kerr emphasizes that offensive rhythm is a byproduct of playing hard and effective team defense.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on De'Anthony Melton's recent performance and role
quotes.excerpt: The common theme with everybody is that the game got a lot harder on the road.
quotes.quote: The common theme with everybody is that the game got a lot harder on the road. We're playing good teams and Steph's not there and faced some ball pressure, some really good individual defenders. So the remedy is the same for all those guys, whether you're talking about Trayce Jackson-Davis or Brandon Podziemski or De'Anthony Melton. It's just play great defense and if we can do that, force some turnovers, create some advantages in transition, that's how you find your way offensively.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr says the remedy for the Warriors struggling role players is the same for everyone: play great defense, force turnovers, and create transition opportunities.

structured.context: Steve Kerr notes that the team's young players are struggling offensively without Stephen Curry and must rely on defense to recover.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on Trayce Jackson-Davis managing the ups and downs of the season
quotes.excerpt: He's going to have to learn how to navigate it, otherwise he'll be balled by next week.
quotes.quote: He's going to have to learn how to navigate it, otherwise he'll be balled by next week and burned out and have to take some time off. You just can't afford to not temper the emotion and the swings of the up and downs of 82 games. It's too difficult. So this is part of his learning experience. He's got to find the equilibrium that comes with there's going to be good stretches, bad ones and as you said, he's seen a lot of both already through 16 games. The hope is the effort is from our staff and his teammates is to help him recognize, you know, even keel will help him a lot.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr on rookie Trayce Jackson-Davis: He has to learn to temper his emotions. You just cannot afford to not temper the emotion and the swings of the up and downs of 82 games.

structured.context: Steve Kerr discusses the importance of Trayce Jackson-Davis learning to manage the emotional ups and downs of an 82-game season.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on Al Horford and Mike Conley's longevity
quotes.excerpt: It takes someone who absolutely loves it to be playing that long.
quotes.quote: It takes someone who absolutely loves it to be playing that long and someone who learns how to be a pro and how to take care of their body. You got to be blessed with good genes too and both guys have checked all three boxes. I watched the game last night and it's great to see Mike Conley out there knocking down threes and Al Horford continues to be one of our leaders and one of our most important people on the team and still a guy who can play at a high level.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr praises the longevity of Al Horford and Mike Conley, saying it takes someone who absolutely loves the game and is blessed with good genes to play at a high level for this long.

structured.context: Steve Kerr praises the longevity and professionalism of veteran players Al Horford and Mike Conley.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on starting Trayce Jackson-Davis
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to start him tonight and I want to give this lineup a look.
quotes.quote: I'm going to start him tonight and I want to give this lineup a look. I like the idea of Draymond Green at the four and having more size, shot blocking, Draymond being able to guard perimeter players. So we're definitely going to give it a look and can't predict how long, but hopefully for the season.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr confirms he is starting Trayce Jackson-Davis tonight. He wants to see more size and shot blocking in the lineup and hopes to keep this look for the rest of the season.

structured.context: Steve Kerr announces his decision to start Trayce Jackson-Davis and shift Draymond Green to the power forward position.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on the team's collective defensive focus
quotes.excerpt: When shots aren't going in, teams tend to slump their shoulders and that's something we've got to be better.
quotes.quote: When shots aren't going in, teams tend to slump their shoulders and that's something we've got to be better with. We pointed that out the other night in Memphis. We really got down on ourselves and that hurt our transition defense. So it's not any one individual, but it's a collective thing and the way you dig your way out of a rut like this is by keeping your energy up, your emotion, your passion. It can't waver, you can't let your guard down, hang your head during the 48. We've got to grind it out the entire game.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr says the Warriors must stop slumping their shoulders when shots do not go in. He says the team cannot let their energy or passion waver during the 48 minutes.

structured.context: Steve Kerr addresses the team's tendency to lose energy and defensive focus when shots are not falling.
